note: CAL FIRE campsites in the redwoods of Jackson Demonstration State Forest, 6 miles east of Fort Bragg off Hwy 20 at mile marker 5.85 (Road 350). Small clusters and single sites spread along the South Fork Noyo and a side creek around the Camp One day-use area; some Redtail sites are for equestrian campers only. Primitive sites, no hookups. --Claude
summary: Jackson DSF Camp One (CAL FIRE): JDSF page (headless) + 2026 Camping Information PDF + 2026 closure notice + campground map + imagery/topo. Keep. WATERFRONT LEAD riverfront -> creekside (SF Noyo is a small stream). Fee $25 -> $20 per CAL FIRE's 2026 sheet (regulation still says $25). Filled 21 sites, 2-vehicle cap, 8 people, 14 nights / 30 a year, season 05-15..09-28 manual. Pin OK. Phone and website confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD riverfront -> creekside: the South Fork Noyo at Camp One is a small coastal stream (the Esri topo draws it as a single line; canopy hides the channel on imagery) - well under 30 m wide. Sites beside it per the CAL FIRE Camp One map: South Fork 1, 2, 3 and South Bend on Rd 350, Roundhouse at the Egg Station by Camp One Host (no per-site coordinates published; all first-come, nightly). Replacement evidence: 'CAL FIRE Camp One map 2026-11-26: South Fork 1-3, South Bend and Roundhouse beside the South Fork Noyo, a small stream (single-line on topo, under redwood canopy) -> creekside'.

FEES CONFLICT: stored $25 came from 14 CCR § 1401.1; CAL FIRE's own Camping Information sheet (PDF created 2026-05-15) says '$20/night' with two vehicles included. Wrote $20 (operator's posted fee) and noted the regulation.

CLOSURES: 'Campsites along Roads 360 and 330 remain closed' (the Camp 3/4/6 sites up Rd 360/361, not the Camp One clusters). Road 350 into Camp One is closed over the 2026-27 winter for stream-crossing repairs; reopening expected spring 2027 - inside the normal off-season.
HORSE: Redtail sites 6-10 are 'open to equestrian campers only' and a separate horse camp is at Camp 20 - explicitly separated from general camping, so not a drop issue.
FIT: no rig-length statement anywhere on CAL FIRE's pages; primitive forest sites on gravel forest roads. Not flagged beyond that.
PIN: 39.39071,-123.68520 sits on the Camp One road junction (Egg Station / host area) - OK.
PHONE 707-964-5674 confirmed (JDSF office). WEBSITE confirmed (403s plain fetches, loads in a browser).

LEAD: CAL FIRE's Camp 20 campgrounds off Hwy 20 near mile marker 17 by Chamberlain Creek - Dunlap (17 sites) and Big River (6 sites), first-come, $20, iron rangers at both (Horse Camp 8 sites is equestrian only) - are not in campgrounds.json (no Dunlap / Camp 20 / other JDSF entry). Same rules and season as Camp One per the 2026 Camping Information PDF; rig fit and exact site coordinates not read.
